headlines.title: How 'Barca way' continues despite big-name exits
headlines.description: Arsenal face a much-changed Barcelona in the Women's Champions League on Thursday - but how have the Spanish giants coped so well with losing key players?

headlines.title: Arsenal join Scott chase - Thursday's gossip
headlines.description: Arsenal contact Bournemouth about midfielder Alex Scott, Manchester United add two defenders to list of potential targets, Aston Villa weigh up move for Chelsea midfielder Romeo Lavia, plus more.

headlines.title: Shirt pull on Isak should have been penalty - panel
headlines.description: Liverpool should have been awarded a penalty against Arsenal for Jurrien Timber's shirt pull on Alexander Isak, says a Premier League panel.
